**Before you file: the roadmap check**

The project keeps its scope line public. Please skim the roadmap's
["Defer until after v1.0" list](
https://github.com/dukeoftoad/toadGALLERY/blob/main/roadmap.md) ---
cloud sync, accounts, social sharing, ads, analytics, always-on
background indexing, online maps/reverse geocoding, complex RAW
development, multi-track video editing/transitions/titles, and broad
format promises are all **deliberately out of scope** for v1.0, and a
request inside those lines will be declined politely but firmly.

Also worth a look: the
[known-limitations doc](
https://github.com/dukeoftoad/toadGALLERY/blob/main/docs/phase-11/known-limitations.md)
--- it lists the already-recorded follow-ups (per-face retouch tuning,
feathered mask edges, the Things browse screen, video geometry, ...),
so if your request is already tracked there, adding a +1 with your use
case to that thread helps prioritize it.
